collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

the owner (2026-11-15): a person named by a role word is a cast villager and shows the name (flavor only: the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: An elder wonders who will remember them once they are gone: say it out loud, or keep it to yourself.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been thinking. After (subject.he/she) is gone, people will remember (subject.him/her) for a while. Then the people who remember (subject.him/her) will be gone too. And then there will be nobody at all who knows that (subject.he/she) liked the sound of rain, or once caught a fish with (subject.his/her) bare hands. Today the thought won't leave (subject.him/her) alone. (friend) sits down beside (subject.him/her).

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) tells (friend) what (subject.he/she) has been thinking. (friend) doesn't argue. "I don't know what happens," (friend.he/she) says honestly. "But I know you like the rain. And I'll tell people." (subject) asks for the fish story, then, to be told properly. They spend the afternoon getting it right.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) doesn't say anything. They just sit together. (child), a child, runs past and shouts, "(subject)! Look! A crab!" and (subject) leans forward to see the crab, which is very small and very angry. For a moment the thought goes away. It will come back. For now there is a crab.
